review_outcome.detail: Host option A applied. FND-001 fixed (83e58c2/184e89c); FND-101 (2nd GET /ws line during an open session) fixed by gating the abort hook. Re-review over 730b55b..HEAD (run 2026-11-16.naruserve.self-w4s2l1r2): round 1 kept FND-201 (block, introduced by 184e89c: flag set before upgrades.run ignored aborts before onOpen -> 500, no listener) and residual FND-202 (NEW-check/flag race); fixed atomically in d8b1c38/1b6fb41 (DefaultResponse.openSession/abortByExchange under the response lock, session onOpen refuses when aborted first). Round 2: both resolved; FND-301 recorded as declared limit (abort after adapter wrote 101 but before onOpen logs one 'GET /ws 200 ... aborted' line; core cannot observe the adapter-side 101); FND-302 rejected as pre-existing since 730b55b (Error from a ws handler in an open session writes a 2nd GET /ws line) - follow-up; FND-203/204/303 rejected. Clean code: CC-201 resolved, CC-301/302 dismissed. Coverage PASS both rounds.

srs_deltas.note: AC-2 race: deliver/runTransfer/sseEnded record COMPLETED only after ex.finish() returns; an abort in that window runs listeners although the body was delivered. Existing FR-HTTP-016 state-machine gap; documented in Response.onAbort javadoc. AC could state that an abort racing completion counts as abnormal.
Listener wrapper catches Throwable (not only RuntimeException) and logs it; SafeCallbacks already swallowed Error silently.

AC-7 on the legacy WebSocket-upgrade path fixed: 184e89c wires HttpExchange.onAbort to the response, 1b6fb41 gates it atomically at the session onOpen (pre-101 aborts abort the response and run listeners once; aborts during an open session write no second request line).
docs/api lacks res.append/onAbort/relay; owned by OPS-DX-009 (later wave).

FND-301: an exchange abort reported after the adapter wrote 101 but before WebSocketEndpoint.onOpen logs one 'GET /ws 200 ... aborted' line and no 101 line; the SPI gives no signal that 101 was written before onOpen. AC-3/AC-8 could state this, or an SPI signal could be added.

FND-302 (pre-existing since 730b55b): an Error thrown by a ws handler during an open session reaches Dispatcher catch(Error) -> res.abort(e) and writes a 2nd 'GET /ws 200 aborted' line after the 101 line.

out_of_lease_paths.reason: Committed in d2049d7: one line res.listenerLogger(errors.logger) in handleLegacy so FR-HTTP-035 AC-4 logs through the app logger on the WebSocket-upgrade path (test FR_HTTP_035_AC4_failedUpgradeFinishRunsListenersAndLogsThroughTheAppLogger). Also touched by the uncommitted review fix. Dispatcher.java is in the stage-2 wave-5 write set. Review fixes: 184e89c registers ex.onAbort in handleLegacy (FR-HTTP-035 AC-7) and 1b6fb41 changes it to res::abortByExchange (removes the pre-upgrade flag).
1b6fb41: onOpen asks DefaultResponse.openSession() and refuses the session (no 101/close line, no handler) when the response was aborted first (review FND-201/FND-202).
1b6fb41: run passes the response to the session (session.response(res)) for the onOpen gate (review FND-201).
